segs: CULTIVATING A VISION
FOR MY CAMPUS
WORKSHEET
These questions will help you articulate your campus
vision. As your vision solidifies, these pages will help
you share it with other students.
4. What vision and promises is the Lord giving you
concerning the kind of person you’ll become in order
to see your vision fulfilled?
1. After spending a significant amount of time in
prayer and the Word, what are your ideas for the
campus two to four years from now?
5. What is God showing you regarding the spiritual
health and training of your student leaders?
2. What specific scriptures are you praying about for
the campus? Write out each verse or passage.
C U LT I VAT I N G A V I S I O N F O R M Y C A M P U S 1
6. Since small plans don’t inflame the minds of men,
what faith stretching events can you do in the next
two to four years to fulfill your vision?
3. What would your campus look like when
these promises are fulfilled (i.e., the spiritual
responsiveness of non-believers, the spiritual walk
of believers, the spiritual tone of the campus, the
character, vision, and biblical convictions of
Christian students, etc.)?
7. In light of the vision God has given you for the next
two to four years, what is He showing you to do or
become this year?
